newsitem.title: USA: UPS says first to meet noisy engine deadline.
newsitem.headline: UPS says first to meet noisy engine deadline.

text.p: United Parcel Service said Tuesday that it is the first carrier to meet the December 1999 Federal deadline for noisy airplanes.
All airlines must meet strict noise limits by 31 December 1999 under a law passed in 1990.
United Parcel Service operates a total of 197 planes. The carrier replaced the engines of 51 of its Boeing 727's - substituting new Rolls-Royce engines for old Pratt & Whitney engines.
The transition alters the area subject to loud noise from 22 square miles, before the engine change, to about 6.5 sq. miles. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
